7496630796531.title: Crius Berry Luscious 100ml - Her
7496630796531.description:
BERRY LUSCIOUS lets you encircle yourself with a signature fruity berry effect that takes you on a remarkable vibrant adventure. Its citrus aroma lets you bloom in an exotic luscious garden.

Top Note: Raspberry, Strawberry, Lemon, Blackcurrant, Mandarin.

Middle Note: Jasmin, Violet, Cashmere, Vanilla, Precious Woods.

Base Note: Amber, Oakmoss, Animal Musk, Patchouly, Carameused Sugar.

7946035331315.title: Crius Corsica 100ml - He
7946035331315.description: Like a deep breath of fresh air, Crius Corsica is a bold composition for a man who is true to himself.

7495985398003.title: Crius Embrace 100ml - Her
7495985398003.description:
EMBRACE completes the poetic rhythm in your everyday life. The floral scent dedicated to elevate the free-spirited women to feel the rush of empowerment and sensuality. It's the perfect aroma to embrace freedom and embrace oneself.

Top Note: Mandarin, White Flowers, White Rose, Lily of the Valley.

Middle Note: Jasmin, Rose Damascene, Sweet Notes, Orchid.

Base Note: Patchouly, White Musk, Amber Note, Vetyver, Carameused Sugar.

7495985660147.title: Crius Flare 100ml - He
7495985660147.description:
FLARE is Power, Rugged, Bold, Raw. All at once, It's the perfect work of art to be true to yourself. This blazing fragrance opens to a compelling rosemary and fresh lemon, giving it the perfect citrus aroma. It continues to blend well with the intense rugged leather and mosses base note for the blazing scent to drive the passion inside of a man.

Top Note: Lemon, Petitgrain, Basil, Rosemary.

Middle Note: Jasmin, Rose, Carnation, Iris.

Base Note: Leather, Oakmoss, Vetyver, Mosses.

7496630829299.title: Crius Gardena 100ml - Her
7496630829299.description:
GARDENA is a floral scent that is expressing a new statement to femininity. The fragrance opens to a desirable scent of Camellia that gives you a refreshing, calming effect. The modern signature aroma adds a delicate touch of jasmine and Cedarwood creating a distinctive flowery silage.

 Top Note: Cassis, Mandarin, Camellia, Lemon, Pink Grapefruit.

Middle Note: Mint, Lily, Violet, Rose, Honeysuckle.

Base Note: Magnolia, Cedarwood, Jasmin, Sandal, Leather.

7495985561843.title: Crius Maximus 100ml - HIM-E20002-Multy
7495985561843.description:
MAXIMUS is the heart of sophisticated fragrances. The strong gust of woody aroma has the absolute contrast of freshness and classy expression of pure exclusivity. It opens with a fresh green note encapsulating you in a refreshing textural element with a rich and tempting base of incense and amber. The perfect aroma that promises a great day ahead of you.

Top Note: Green Notes, Pimento, Pepper, Nutmeg.

Middle Note: Clary Sage, Elemi, Cashmere, Patchouly.

Base Note: Amber, Mosses, Incense.

7495985725683.title: Crius Night Fall 100ml
7495985725683.description:
NIGHT FALL is a classic sensual rare scent suited well for your special occasions and daily wear. The cozy Jasmine aroma goes well with Saffron and Rose Damascene to create a rich fragrance, and finishes off with a sweet Vanilla and Amber base notes. The mystical scent evokes the memories of the perfect moments.

Top Note: Rose Damascene, Saffron, Jasmin.

Middle Note: Cashmere, Patchouly, Guaiac Wood.

Base Note: Vanilla, Oud, Amer Notes.

7495985496307.title: Crius Paradise 100ml - HER
7495985496307.description:
PARADISE is a long-lasting fragrance that has the aroma of a free spirit. The scent opens with fruity notes of Pear and Blackcurrant. Under the heart of the scent, it adds a note of refreshing vanilla giving it a sensual and heavenly effect.

Top Note: Shinus Molle, Pear, Blackcurrant.

Middle Note: Rose, Jasmine Sambac, Heliotrope.

Base Note: Cedarwood, Vanilla.

7495985332467.title: Crius Temptation 100ml - Her
7495985332467.description:
TEMPTATION blends in precious and intense tailor-made floral ingredients to express the essence of femininity. The entire scent is encircled in the vibrant signature note Gardenia which always touches the right mood capturing the essence of charismatic woman.

Top Note: Ylang Ylang, Bergamot, Blackcurrant, Gardenia.

Middle Note: Orchid, Lotus Flowers, Precious Woods, Fruity Noted, Vanilla.

Base Note: Incense, Patchouly, Amber, Vetyver, Chocolate.

8076501745907.title: Crius Tropical Resort 100ml - HER-E10009-Multy
8076501745907.description: Experience the essence of a tropical resort with our HER Crius Tropical Resort fragrance in a 100ml bottle.
